'''Apex One''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] he was among the prisoners who managed to escape from their cells following an Imperial attack. However, before he could leave the [[Minimum Security Section]] and find true freedom, he was killed.
